windows.notes: Windows 1.4.4 build 7 adds the continuous spectrum activity ring, clearer success and warning indicators, a transparent prism icon, redesigned settings and provider logos. OpenAI Codex is first for new setups; existing saved provider choices and credentials are preserved.

mac.notes: Mac 1.4.4 build 7 adds clearer success and warning indicators, redesigned settings with provider logos, and the transparent menu-bar prism. OpenAI Codex is first for new setups; existing saved provider choices and credentials are preserved.
